title: Icon set before the style guide
caption: Text-only prompts: about, bluetooth, screenshot, display and trash drift to flat or straight-on views.

title: Icon set after the style guide
caption: Generated against the reference set (docs/ICONS.md): the outliers are now three-quarter view like the rest.

title: First Tracker desktop
caption: Volumes and Home beside the Deskbar, Trash in the corner. Labels were off-centre (centred galleys double-offset) and ~/Desktop items were missing.

title: Tracker and Get Info in dark mode
caption: Get Info rows on an exact LABEL_ROW + TIGHT grid, window sized to its content.

title: Tracker desktop, folder window and Get Info (light)
caption: Selected labels inverted as on BeOS, highlight balanced on cap height and baseline; links in italics; executable scripts get the executable icon.

title: Tracker list view
caption: Sortable ColumnListView with 16 px icons; count and free space in the bar beside the scroll bar.

title: Tracker: editing a name in place
caption: BeOS-style inline rename replaces the Rename dialog: the field sits on the label's own baseline and lines up with the selection highlight; the name without its extension starts selected.

title: Tracker: column view
caption: macOS-style column view (⌘4): one column per folder level, auto-hiding scroll bars, and a preview pane with an async thumbnail and file facts.

title: Tracker: Find
caption: Find takes focus on open, closes with ⌘W, shows home-relative locations and a baseline-aligned status.

title: Menus: shortcut glyphs on the baseline
caption: ⌘, ⇧ and arrows come from a fallback font; each is now laid out separately so it shares the item's baseline. The Trash is titled Trash.

title: Tracker: Find searches contents with ripgrep
caption: Find is built on ripgrep's crates (ignore + grep-searcher): parallel walk, smart case, .gitignore-aware, binary files skipped. Contents matches show the line number and text; live progress, Stop/Escape cancel.

title: Tracker Status: background file operations
caption: Copy, move, duplicate, Trash and Empty Trash run on worker threads (copy_file_range in chunks). Jobs longer than 0.4 s appear here with bytes, items, current file and time left; Stop cancels and removes the partial copy.

title: In-place reload: before
caption: Tracker (desktop + Home window, Home icon selected) and Deskbar under tabula-session, before rebuilding and running tabula-session reload.

title: In-place reload: after an upgrade
caption: After tabula-session reload with new tabula-session, app_server and Tracker binaries: the session re-executed itself, restarted app_server, and Tracker re-executed with its saved state. Pixel-identical to the screenshot before.

title: Tracker: live updates
caption: Folder windows, columns and the desktop now follow the disk as it changes via inotify, with no polling. Shot 120 ms after a shell wrote download.iso, renamed notes.md, deleted photo-02.jpg and made Archive. Selection and sort are kept; a deleted folder says so.

title: Terminal (light)
caption: Tabula Light scheme: 16 ANSI colours tuned for contrast on paper white, SGR attributes and truecolor, CJK/Greek/symbol fallback fonts, box drawing drawn as geometry (rounded and heavy), block elements, a kitty-protocol inline image, and a compiler-style path link.

title: Terminal (dark)
caption: The same session in Tabula Dark (graphite, soft pastels). The scheme follows the desktop theme, and OSC 10/11 colour queries answer from it, so TUIs like Claude Code choose the matching theme.
